Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference — demo request (saw you on AWS Marketplace)

Hi Ben,

I came across Redwood Inference on the AWS Marketplace and wanted to reach out — we're evaluating inference platforms for production LLM workloads. Quick details about us: WonderTech (early-stage fintech), team is evaluating throughput and cost for our customer-facing assistant.

Would love a short intro + demo next week to understand latency, pricing model, and what a dedicated deployment looks like. Attendees from our side would be me (CTO) and Patricia Nguyen (AI engineer).

Can you share availability? We're PST based but flexible.

Thanks,
Alex

--

CTO, WonderTech
alex.johnson@wondertech.com

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for reaching out, and welcome if you found us on the Marketplace!

I work on inbound at Redwood — happy to set up a 30-minute intro + demo to cover:
- short product overview and hosted vs dedicated options
- performance / latency profiles and typical unit economics
- quick Q&A on your use case and next steps (trial, dedicated eval)

Proposed slots next week (PST):
- Tue Jan 12, 10:00–10:30 AM
- Wed Jan 13, 2:00–2:30 PM
- Thu Jan 14, 11:00–11:30 AM

If none of those work, send a couple options and we'll accommodate. I cc'd Marissa (AE) and Camila (SE) to join the call for pricing and technical deep-dive.

Also sharing our marketplace listing and a short HubSpot record so we can track the runbook: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-Redwood-Inference and https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/53421

Best,
Ben

Hi Alex / Patricia — quick note from the SE side. Thanks for sharing the agenda items — helpful. If you can send an estimate of peak tokens/sec or a sample anonymized prompt pattern, I can tailor the demo to show realistic latency/cost tradeoffs and the Dedicated config we'd recommend.

Sample items that are helpful (optional):
- avg request length (tokens) and peak concurrent requests
- whether you plan to use streaming responses or batch generation
- any preferred cloud region for Dedicated or VPC setup

If you prefer just to talk through during the demo, that's fine — we'll cover the recommended configs and cost estimates in the call.

See you on Jan 13.
— Camila
